customSections.content: This page covers the UCPS 2027–28 traditional calendar. UCPS currently lists a separate 2027–28 Wolfe School calendar. Families in other specialized programs should check the district calendar page for newly published calendars.

customSections.label: Family Planning: Breaks and Other No-School Days
customSections.content: In addition to the longer Thanksgiving, winter, and spring periods, students on the traditional calendar have 12 other weekdays off: September 6; October 11; November 2 and 11; January 17, 18, and 19; February 21; March 7 and 27; April 14; and May 29.

definitions.description: Students are out all five weekdays, November 22–26. UCPS marks November 22–24 as optional teacher workdays and November 25–26 as holidays.

Students are out December 20–January 3. UCPS marks December 20 and 31 as optional teacher workdays; December 21–22 and 28–30 as annual leave; and December 23–24, December 27, and January 3 as holidays. Students return January 4.
Students have three consecutive weekdays off for Martin Luther King Jr. Day, an optional teacher workday, and a required teacher workday.
UCPS marks Friday, April 14 as a holiday, followed by annual leave April 17–21. Students therefore have six consecutive weekdays without school from April 14 through April 21.

customSections.label: What’s New for 2027–28
customSections.content: Changes families may notice from the UCPS 2026–27 traditional calendar.

definitions.description: School starts August 23, one day earlier than in 2026–27.
School ends June 7, three calendar days later than in 2026–27.
Students have five weekdays off November 22–26, compared with three weekdays in 2026–27.
The student no-school stretch runs December 20–January 3, one weekday longer than the December 21–January 1 period in 2026–27.
Annual leave moves to April 17–21. Students are also off April 14, creating six consecutive weekdays without school.

calendarFaqs.q: Which 2027–28 UCPS calendar should families use?
calendarFaqs.a: This page covers the UCPS traditional calendar. UCPS currently publishes a separate 2027–28 Wolfe School calendar. Families in other specialized programs should check the district calendar page for newly published calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Are teacher workdays included on this page?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. This page includes teacher workdays when students on the UCPS traditional calendar are not scheduled to attend school. The event description keeps the district’s specific workday label when it matters.
UCPS currently lists a separate 2027–28 Wolfe School calendar. The district calendar page did not list a 2027–28 Early College printable calendar when this page was reviewed on August 11, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the 2027–28 calendar still change before school begins?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. UCPS may revise a future-year calendar or publish additional program calendars. Check the official district calendar page before booking nonrefundable travel or relying on an older download.

sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed 175 instructional days, with 85 student days in the first semester and 90 in the second.

Checked every color-coded student no-school date in the Traditional Schools PDF, including the November 2 and March 7 district professional-development days, the November 22–24 optional teacher workdays, and the January 18–19 teacher workdays.
Grouped Thanksgiving, winter, and spring dates into family-friendly ranges while preserving the official teacher-workday, annual-leave, and holiday categories in the descriptions.
Checked the UCPS calendar page and Wolfe School PDF to confirm that Wolfe currently has a separate 2027–28 calendar; no 2027–28 Early College printable calendar was listed when reviewed.
The one-time ICS file uses the reviewed traditional calendar dates shown on this page and does not update automatically after district revisions.
